changelog: **One verified chat interaction endpoint (#1948):** `POST /api/integrations/chat/[platform]/interactions` is the single public entry point for Slack and Teams buttons. In strict order: raw body read once → platform signature (Slack v0 HMAC via `verifySlackSignature`, Teams Bot Framework JWT via `verifyBotFrameworkRequest`) → replay window (±5 min, and a Slack signature is accepted once) → rate limit per (workspace, member) → parse + dispatch; every refusal is the same opaque 401. `src/lib/chat/interactions/` holds the pure envelope parser, the action registry (`registerChatAction`) and the dispatcher, which re-derives the person from an ENABLED workspace + a person-confirmed `ChatIdentity` + an active user of the same org on every request — a payload id is only a lookup key; an unlinked or unconfirmed member gets an ephemeral "link your account first" reply and no handler runs. Slack is acked at once and answered on its `response_url` (hooks.slack.com only, SSRF-checked; `CHAT_RESPONSE_URL_ALLOW_INSECURE_STUB=1` is the e2e sink's switch); a Teams Universal Action (also via the bot's messages endpoint) is answered in the invoke response. First built-in action: `meetings.upcoming` (the clicker's own next three meetings, in their zone and language). New `chatInteraction` i18n namespace (EN/TR/DE). Pinned by `e2e/chat-interactions.spec.ts` and `e2e/chat-interaction-envelope.unit.spec.ts` (@smoke).

en: Buttons in Slack and Teams now act as you — only after you have confirmed your chat link. First one: “my next meetings”, answered right in the chat.
tr: Slack ve Teams'teki düğmeler artık senin adına çalışıyor — yalnızca sohbet bağlantını onayladıktan sonra. İlki: “sıradaki toplantılarım”, cevabı doğrudan sohbette.
de: Schaltflächen in Slack und Teams handeln jetzt in deinem Namen – erst nachdem du deine Chat-Verknüpfung bestätigt hast. Die erste: „meine nächsten Meetings“, direkt im Chat beantwortet.
